svg.text: Brisbane-based hobbyist software developer focused on experimental web experiences.
I don't think programming is about remembering everything I've ever written.
If I build an incredible project today and forget how I made it later,
that doesn't make the achievement any less mine.
Before I started building it, I didn't know how to build it either.
The valuable skill isn't memorising every algorithm.
It's trusting that I can experiment, fail, rebuild and learn it again.

g.text: Portfolio • Creative UI • Experimental Web Experiences
Interactive image processing with live pixel scaling.
